content: Root cause: The bug was caused by incorrectly specifying the "max-virtual-functions" property in the PCIe endpoint (EP) nodes of the device tree. The original implementation used 16-bit values, which was inappropriate for the context, as the correct specification should have been 8-bit values. This mismatch could lead to incorrect handling of virtual functions in the PCIe configuration, potentially causing issues in device functionality or resource allocation.
